responsibility: Performs late name resolution over the fully expanded crate after modules, imports, and macros have been set up. It walks items, expressions, patterns, types, lifetimes, labels, and doc links; resolves lexical bindings and remaining paths that do not need type checking; enforces rib-based scope restrictions; records resolution results and auxiliary metadata; and drives late-resolution diagnostics for unresolved or invalid names. It is also responsible for error recovery when resolving generic parameters, including duplicate type or const parameter names. When a generic parameter is diagnosed as duplicated, this pass must avoid recording a normal resolution for that invalid binding, because later HIR analysis, generic argument lowering, or substitution may otherwise consume a malformed const/type parameter resolution and ICE.
